odia: ଆସିବୁ ଯିବୁରେ କଳାମାଣିକ! ତୋହରି ପାଇଁ କି ନିତି ଗଞ୍ଜଣା, ପିଠିରେ ତିନ୍ତୁଳି ଛାଟ
title: Visits and a painful complaint
literal_meaning: Provisional reading: come and go, dark jewel! Must there be daily reproach for you, a tamarind switch on the back?
explanation: The address joins coming and going to a question about repeated reproach and a switch on the back. The dictionary defines the switch but does not identify who speaks, visits, receives a blow or inflicts one. Our reading hears a complaint about a connection’s painful cost, while leaving those roles open. It neither reconstructs a romance nor justifies punishment.
meaning_odia: ଆସିବାଯିବାର ସମ୍ବୋଧନ ସହ ନିତି ଗଞ୍ଜଣା ଓ ପିଠିରେ ଛାଟର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଅଛି। ଏହା ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ; କିଏ କହୁଛନ୍ତି, ଯାଆନ୍ତି, ମାଡ଼ ଖାଆନ୍ତି ବା ଦିଅନ୍ତି, ଉତ୍ସ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଏକ ସମ୍ପର୍କର କଷ୍ଟକୁ ନେଇ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ଏଥିରୁ ପ୍ରେମକାହାଣୀ ତିଆରି କରୁନାହୁଁ ବା ଦଣ୍ଡକୁ ଯଥାର୍ଥ କହୁନାହୁଁ।
english_summary: Our provisional reading hears complaint without assigning the unnamed roles.
odia_summary: ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅଛି; ଅକୁହା ଭୂମିକା ଭରିଦିଆଯାଏନାହିଁ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟିକୁ ପ୍ରେମକାହାଣୀ କହିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, କଥକ ଓ ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଉତ୍ସ କେଉଁଠି ଚିହ୍ନାଇଛି? / An imagined reader questions an unsupported romantic reconstruction. The exchange is invented.
cultural_context: No gender, lover, deity, actual assault or disciplinary custom established. The dictionary’s adjacent physical claims about switches are not adopted as practical guidance.
